tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides robust attribution scores grounded in game theory, capturing consistent feature impacts. LIME offers local interpretability to validate whether minor feature changes alter prediction direction. Integrated Gradients smooth attribute gradients from baseline, helping identify spurious patterns. Sensitivity analysis confirms causal impact by ablation, detecting features whose removal shifts prediction toward correct class, indicating spurious influence.
